about.title: The problems behind the product
about.body: I enjoy solving the engineering problems behind great products: making uploads resilient, designing APIs that are easy to maintain, debugging tricky failures, and turning machine-learning experiments into usable services. My work spans TypeScript and Python backends, React interfaces, cloud deployment, testing, and collaborative development. I care about understanding how a system behaves in production—not just making a demo work.
about.approach: I start by reproducing the problem and reading the code that is already there. I prefer small pull requests with tests, I write down decisions and tradeoffs so the next person doesn't have to guess, and I measure before saying something got faster.
